title: IK silently straightens the limb when the target is out of reach
summary: Two-bone IK straightens a limb into a 'dancer kick' when the target is out of reach, with no warning. Check the returned miss (footTo returns it): over 3 cm, move the target or body.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: const miss = footTo(f, 'L', target, pole); if (miss > .03) console.warn('foot misses by', miss);

doc.when: Every IK call on a static pose.
doc.avoid: Assuming a placed hand/foot touches its target.
gotchas: The kit's handTo has a contactReport(); footTo returns its miss.

problem.symptom: A leg or arm shoots out straight toward a point it can't reach.
problem.cause: IK clamps the reach and gives no error.
problem.fix: Check the miss; move the target within reach or the body closer.
